items.text: in a panel's bottom band, the pin, back, next and close sit in the lower right corner again (the Pack panel had them by its tab)

adding a pack shows its sounds grouped by what they do, in plain words (Touch: plays when you touch the stage; On the beat; Bed: plays softly underneath, all the time; Pattern: follows the drawing), then Add or Cancel; any sound can be changed later under Your sounds
in the Pack panel, Import a file shows a page and Import a folder a folder, each with an arrow going in
the Field panel names itself at the top and wears its mark by its name in the band, like the other panels
each pack in the library wears a simple mark for what it holds (a sound, a drawing in code, a picture, a material), or its own cover, and names its author: Water by Dimitry Saïd Chamy

the In button on the bar wears the ring's mark and opens the In ring: camera, picture, video, mic, file, sound and pack, plus remove while a source is on. Its caret opens the In drawer as before, and a hold still opens the In shelf. The In ring is also one of the rings you can switch to on the stage
the Beats | Water switch under Sound wears its icons, the beat grid and the pack box, and each has a mark in its top right corner that opens its panel: Beats goes to the Beats tab, Water to the Pack
the Beat tab is now Beats

the gear on Auto play's Changes tiles is now a lighter mark, a dot in the tile's top right corner with a quarter arc around it; a swipe left from that corner still opens it. The Pro padlock moved to the top left
the founders' names have moved from the credits to the Founders Club section of the index, each with their founder number
a shelf's last button (panel, index) has its label on the same line as the others, with a light rule before it
the Sound ring's bytes dot wears the Bytes tab's braces, not G-code's angle brackets
the index button wears a side pane, since it opens the drawer at the side, not a panel that rises
opening Current right after an update no longer sends a crash report by itself (the update's one reload was taken for a crash)
the sign-up card is the Founders 100 Club, and how many have joined is a progress bar, on the card, on the welcome and in the index
founders can be credited by name in Current's credits, with a box to tick when they join
the card's terms, behind a small Terms toggle that rises over the foot of the form: free to join, first come first served, not a contest or sweepstakes, and no ownership, shares or equity in anything
a pinned ring stays where you put it: a double-tap elsewhere no longer moves it, its pin flashes instead
the Play ring's middle shows its play arrow again (0.33.13 dropped it)
double-tap a ring's middle to fold its buttons in and leave just the round middle where it is; double-tap it again to bring them back
the Sound ring's middle is a plain speaker, the name of the ring; touching it while nothing plays starts the sound, as every speaker does
every speaker says the same thing: the bar's and the rings' volume dots show the speaker crossed out when nothing can be heard: sound off, muted, or the volume at zero
with the volume at zero, a tap on any speaker gives the volume back (the last one you had)
